purpose: Determine whether selective local review is a learnable decision on positive polyp localization. A mechanism feasibility diagnostic, not full SkillOpt training or sequential HCL.
roles: All 12 original training source groups, paired; fit on training only. Freeze rule before any evaluation on all 12 previously assigned development groups. No use of the 8 old confirmation groups or official test. Patient independence unknown.
actions: Compute one full-image localization. Stop returns that exact box. Review uses the incumbent fixed procedure: expand the same box by 0.15 per side then relocalize once in that ROI. Both scored directly in original coordinates. Invalid output scores zero; if the first box is invalid both actions fail. No replacement or retries.
signals: From the first box only: area fraction <=0.15, >=0.4, or nearest frame edge <=0.02 (normalized per axis). Optional frozen Qwen reads full image with first box outlined, before review and without gold. It returns TIGHT, LOOSE, CLIPPED, MISSED or UNSURE. Visual policy reviews LOOSE/CLIPPED/MISSED; UNSURE or unparsable stops. Constants never-review and always-review included. No cutoff tuning.
selection: Maximize mean paired IoU on training among six policies, tie to fewer mean VLM calls, then listed order. Leave one training source out in turn as sensitivity. Costs include first localization, optional visual judgment, and crop localization when taken. All comparisons share realized outcomes.
advance: Open historical development only if at least one training pair gains >=0.05 IoU, one loses >=0.05, and per-case hindsight upper bound exceeds better constant by >=0.02. Freeze winner even if constant. For support on development require a nonconstant mixed policy, mean IoU >= better constant +0.02, success count no lower than both, and average VLM cost no higher than always-review. No retraining on development. Report quality/cost separately.
metrics: Per-arm mean IoU (invalid=0), success at IoU>=0.5, paired success gains/losses, counts of material gain/loss/tie band, upper bound and decision headroom, realized calls. Upper bound uses gold only after both actions; never deploy.
